tarawa-kiribati.reason: Satellite imagery rather than a ground-level real photo, and it does not provide a recognizable city view of Tarawa.

tanbaly-kazakhstan.reason: Real petroglyph photo, but it is identified as Tamgaly-Tas, a different site from the Tanbaly (Tamgaly) World Heritage property.

tel-aviv.reason: Real photo in Tel Aviv, but it isolates Reading Power Station rather than showing the city.

teraina.reason: NASA orbital/satellite view rather than an on-location real photo suitable for representing the place.

tepui-auyan.reason: Real photo, but it is a close-up of Heliamphora plants and does not show Auyan-tepui itself.

timgad-ruins.reason: Real panoramic photo clearly showing the archaeological ruins of Timgad.

thanh-hoa.reason: Historical ceremony photo at ancestral tombs; it does not show a city view of Thanh Hoa.

troy.reason: Real photo taken from the Troy site, but the subject is the outward landscape/view rather than clearly visible Troy ruins.

tiwanaku-kalasasaya.reason: A historical illustration/print, not a real photograph.

tulum-ruins.reason: Real photo clearly showing the Tulum archaeological ruins.

tuvalu-vaiaku.reason: Real photo showing the broader Funafuti/Vaiaku township rather than an isolated landmark.

valley-of-queens-luxor.reason: Real on-location photo clearly showing the Valley of the Queens landscape and site.

university-of-coimbra-d34-73.reason: Real panoramic photo clearly showing the University of Coimbra courtyard and surrounding university architecture.

vatnajökull-d34-44.reason: Real landscape photo showing Breidamerkurjokull, an outlet glacier of the Vatnajokull ice cap.

valley-of-kings.reason: Real aerial photograph clearly showing the Valley of the Kings and its surrounding terrain.

vlkolinec-slovakia.reason: Real photo clearly showing the historic village and its characteristic streetscape.

vostok-island.reason: Real photograph from an approaching boat clearly showing Vostok Island's coastal profile.

wartburg-castle.reason: Real photo clearly showing Wartburg Castle in its setting.

wales-alaska.reason: Wrong place: the photo shows the Community Hall in Wales, Utah, not Wales, Alaska.

yaren-nauru.reason: Real street-level photo showing Yaren's built environment rather than an isolated monument.

udi.reason: Real photo, but it isolates a post-office building and does not provide a city or town view of Udi.

zaranj.reason: Real street-level photo taken in Zaranj that shows the city's streets and surrounding urban fabric.
